title: Predictive soft-gate and cooperative slot reevaluation for continuous batcher
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Adds a lightweight predictive admission gate and a cooperative slot-reevaluation pass to the continuous batcher to reduce long-tail (p95/p99) latency for KV-heavy and mixed-priority traffic. Motivation: We observed spikes when low-priority, KV-pinned micro-batches accumulated and delayed higher-priority short requests. Existing hard preemption and fixed timeout heuristics either caused throughput churn or failed to prevent starvation. This change introduces a prediction layer that detects steep age growth and a short soft gate to temporarily delay low-priority admissions, combined with a non-disruptive slot-reevaluation that opportunistically moves high pin-cost slots to lower-impact micro-batches. Design: StarvationPredictor maintains small fixed-width buckets over a short window and computes an EWMA slope and occupancy ratio to generate a score. SoftGate delays low-priority admissions for a jittered 1-8ms window when the score exceeds thresholds; the window is intentionally short to limit user-visible delay while improving batching for higher-priority traffic. SlotReevaluation is cooperative: it flags candidate slots and attempts best-effort reassignment without forcing hard preemption; receiving micro-batches get a brief reservation to warm KV state. KV placement_hints surface a PinCostEstimate used for tie-breaking during reevaluation. Feature flag (runtime.feature.predictive_gate=false by default) and telemetry are included. Observability: metrics added: batcher.predictor.score, batcher.gate.delay_ms, batcher.reeval.attempts, batcher.reeval.success_rate. Bench summary: throughput change: -0.7% (noise), p50: -1.4%, p95: -18%, p99: -9%, scheduler CPU +2.1% average. Safety: feature-flagged rollout; CI perf-check added to gate regressions. Rollout: enable 10% traffic on Dedicated initially; monitor predictor score and p95. Merge: squash-merged after approvals and green perf-check. References: ENG-3821.

review_comments: Omar Reyes: 'Why 6ms? Concerned about amplification under high ingress.'

Maya Chen (author): '6ms came from sweep balancing batching benefits and user-visible delay. We jitter the window to avoid sync; feature flag can disable if amplified. Added tests for high ingress bursts.'
Talia Gupta: 'Slot reevaluation seems safe but could race with KV eviction; ensure non-blocking hints.'
Maya Chen: 'PinCostEstimate is lock-free and uses recent stats snapshot; added comment and safeguards.'
Hector Alvarez: 'Please add perf-check so future PRs don't regress p95.'
Maya Chen: 'Added targeted perf-check job; CI will fail PRs that regress p95 by >5% on the representative scenario.'
